title: Concept: Pubspec that targets a non-default publication endpoint
description: pubspec.yaml declares a `publish_to` value that is not `none`, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `publish_to` value that is not `none`.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through pubspec.yaml (pub).
risk: A name or scope that resolves outside the project's intended registry is fetched from a source nobody reviewed, so a publish there becomes an install here. This rule reads a `publish_to` value that is not `none`.
